description: For mandates with a co-sign threshold, check whether a specific spend needs the principal to approve it and get the exact digest they must sign. The digest binds the mandate, the transfer AND the amount, so an approval cannot be reused for a different payment — do not attempt to reuse one. If a large spend is refused for want of a countersignature, present the digest to the principal rather than splitting the spend to slip under the threshold.
name: robyn_mandate_cosign_request
title: Does this spend need the principal to approve it?
